Topic 1.2: Selected Chapters (Surah) • Surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) • Surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Selected Chapters (Surah) • Surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) • Surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20), part of Qur’an 1.1 Ulumul Qur’an (8 lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, the learner s in Grade 7 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What lessons do Muslims learn from the selected surah? 2. How can a Muslim apply the teachings of the selected surah?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read the selected surah,

2. discuss the meaning of the selected surah and make class presentations,

3. research on the teachings/lessons from selected surah online/on available reference materials in pairs and make class presentations,

4. dramatise teachings/lessons from Surah Ad-Dhuha (treatment of orphans, needy and bounties of Allah). 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read the selected surah,
2. discuss the meaning of the selected surah and make class presentations,
3. research on the teachings/lessons from selected surah online/on available reference materials in pairs and make class presentations,
4. dramatise teachings/lessons from Surah Ad-Dhuha (treatment of orphans, needy and bounties of Allah). 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Selected Chapters (Surah) • Surah Ad- Dhuha (Q.93:1-11) • Surah Al- Balad (Q. 90:1-20) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: the learner interacts with digital technology when researching online the teachings/lessons from the

selected surah

• Citizenship: social and civic skills as learners dramatise teachings/lessons from the selected surah (treatment of orphans,

respect for parents and humility)

• Learning to Learn: the learners develop relationships as they share learnt knowledge during class presentations on

teachings/lessons from the selected surah.

Values:
• Social Justice: the learners cooperate during dramatization on the teachings/lessons from the selected surah (treatment of

orphans.

• Respect: as the learners dramatise the ways of showing respect and humility to the parents.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Citizenship: social cohesion is promoted as the learners dramatise the teachings lessons from the selected surah (treatment of

orphans, respect for parents and humility).

Link to other Subjects:

Creative Arts and Sports: the learners apply the skills in creative arts when dramatizing teachings/lessons from the surah Ad- Dhuha (treatment of orphans and needy, appreciating the bounties of Allah).
